assistant.rb.gradeA: Grade A means the crop met the platform's quality checklist: good size rating, acceptable/good moisture, 3% or less visible damage, 2% or less foreign material, and good appearance. Grades are assigned manually by an FPO field officer or admin and can be verified — see Module: Quality Grading.
assistant.rb.transportEarn: Transport cost is subtracted per quintal from the selling price to get your Net Realization. Use Market Comparison to see the transport-cost breakdown for each market — a nearer market with a slightly lower price can sometimes net you more than a distant market with a higher headline price.
assistant.rb.recommendNoContext: Open Market Intelligence and enter your crop, quantity and location — the platform will rank nearby markets by net realization, not just headline price.
assistant.rb.recommendWithContext: Based on current data, {market} shows the strongest recommendation score ({score}/100) for your crop: {reasons}. Open Market Comparison to see the full breakdown and all other options.
assistant.rb.whyRecommendedNoContext: Recommendations are based on net realization, transport distance, recent price trend, and current buyer demand — see the score breakdown on the Market Comparison screen.
assistant.rb.generic: I can help explain net realization, quality grades, market comparisons, and buyer matches using your platform data. Try asking about a specific crop, market, or lot. For anything beyond that, please use the Market Intelligence and Comparison screens directly — the core recommendations do not depend on this assistant.
assistant.rb.noteNoApiKey: AI API not configured for this deployment — answered using platform data and rule templates. The core platform works fully without this.
assistant.rb.noteTempUnavailable: Assistant temporarily unavailable — answered using platform data and rule templates instead.

forecast.title: Price Forecast
forecast.subtitle: A demo statistical baseline that predicts a future modal price from recent market trends.
forecast.emptyState: Choose a crop, market and horizon, then run the forecast.
forecast.invalidHorizon: Horizon must be a positive whole number of days.
forecast.requestFailed: Could not fetch the forecast. Please try again.
forecast.insufficientData: Not enough historical data for this crop/market yet ({rows} rows found). Try a different market or crop.
forecast.footerNote: Forecasts are a small statistical baseline trained on demo-seeded historical data — not a production-grade or guaranteed prediction.
assistant.rb.forecastAccuracy: The Price Forecast page runs a real ridge-regression baseline over that crop/market's seeded price history and shows its actual MAE, RMSE and R² — not a fixed accuracy percentage, since it depends on how many historical rows exist for that pair. Small-sample pairs honestly show a weaker or even negative R² rather than a made-up number, and pairs with too little data return "insufficient data" instead of a guess. Open Price Forecast and run it for your crop and market to see the real figures.
